assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
Diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is medically necessary to correlate the patient's intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm
The medical necessity is documented in the clinical indication note
